approach: Turn cognate spotting into cognate making: three conversion rules (-tion to -ción, -ity to -idad, -ly to -mente) with the gender and accent facts that come with them and the false friends that break the rule.
coverage: -tion → -ción: nation → nación, information → información, conversation → conversación
-ción words are feminine and lose the accent in the plural: la nación, las naciones
-ity → -idad: university → universidad, activity → actividad, possibility → posibilidad
-ly → -mente, added to the feminine adjective: finally → finalmente, rapidly → rápidamente
An adjective's accent stays: rápido → rápidamente, fácil → fácilmente
Watch out: actualmente = currently (not actually); eventualmente = possibly, occasionally (not eventually)

data.cueNote: The stress lands on -ción and -dad: na-CIÓN, u-ni-ver-si-DAD. A -mente word keeps the stress of its adjective and adds one on MEN: RÁ-pi-da-MEN-te.

blocks.purpose: States the accent and gender facts that come with -ción and -mente.

data.anchor: Nouns ending in -ción, -sión and -dad are feminine, and a -ción noun drops its accent in the plural.
prerequisites: la nación → las naciones; la canción → las canciones.
la ciudad, la universidad, la realidad: all feminine.
-mente keeps any accent of its adjective: rápido → rápidamente, fácil → fácilmente.
-mente is added to the feminine form: lenta → lentamente.

cautions.title: actualmente = currently
cautions.detail: Actualmente means at present, nowadays. For "actually", say en realidad.

cautions.title: eventualmente = possibly, occasionally
cautions.detail: For "eventually" (in the end), say al final or con el tiempo.

data.question: Which Spanish word is the everyday word for "a question" (something you ask)?

trapReasons.1: Cuestión follows the -tion rule, so it looks like the obvious answer.

data.whyIntuitionFailed: The rule works so often that learners apply it everywhere.
data.correctReasoning: Cuestión exists but means an issue or a matter. A question you ask is una pregunta, as in Tengo una pregunta.
data.recoveryTip: Rules make good guesses; common words still need checking.

blocks.purpose: Closes with the three rules and the two exceptions.

data.takeaway: -tion becomes -ción, -ity becomes -idad, -ly becomes -mente: and actualmente means currently, not actually.

checks.rationale: -ity becomes -idad, and the double s becomes one: possibility → posibilidad.
checks.hint: Swap -ity for -idad, and Spanish rarely doubles an s.
